events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your trip and found part of the route was longer than it needed to be, so you're getting $2.69 back. That amount comes to you as a Ryde voucher, applied to your account for your next ride. The rest of the metered fare stands, since only the extra distance was affected. Nothing else changes on your account — no flags, no further steps on your side. Thanks for flagging it.

DRIVER: We reviewed the route on this trip. The extra distance wasn't justified: no traffic incident on the replaced stretch backed up the congestion reason you gave, and on a metered taxi trip extra distance goes straight into the fare. The rider is getting $2.69 back as a Ryde voucher; that amount is covered by Ryde, not deducted from your earnings. Keep giving accurate route reasons in future — repeated unsupported claims can lead to account review.
